shots.narration_dhivehi: އެއީ... އެއީ އޭނާ ނުބުނޭ. އެކަމަކު އޭނާ ބުނި އެމީހުން މާލޭގައިވެސް އެބައުޅެޔޭ.
shots.narration_english: That... that he didn't say. But he said those people are in Malé too.
shots.speaker: moosa

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަޝްހަމް، އަހަރެންގެ ދަރިފުޅު މަރާލި މީހުން ހޯދައިދީ. އަހަރެން ކޮންމެފަދަ ގުރުބާނީއެއްވެސް ވެދާނަން.
shots.narration_english: Ashham, find the people who killed my son. I will make any sacrifice.
shots.speaker: moosa

beats.new_image_reason: emotional turning point: Moosa weeps; Ashham stands and puts a hand on his shoulder
beats.location: Moosa's luxurious living room in Malé: polished marble floor, big cream leather sofas, dark wood panelling and furniture, warm table lamps, heavy curtains
beats.mood: night, warm amber table lamps in a dim luxurious room, deep shadows, heavy grief and silence
beats.visual: Moosa weeping on the sofa, his face crumpled with grief, a hand pressed to his eyes under his gold glasses; Ashham standing beside him with one hand resting on Moosa's shoulder, looking down with a hard, determined face
beats.camera: medium close shot, eye level, faces in the upper two-thirds, a calm uncluttered lower third (sofa and floor in shadow)

shots.narration_dhivehi: މޫސާ ރޮމުން ބުނި. އަޝްހަމް ތެދުވެ މޫސާގެ ކޮނޑުގައި އަތްޖަހާލި. އޭނާއަށް އެނގުނު ގޮތުގައި ނާއިލް މަރާލާފައިވަނީ ހަމައެކަނި ބަދަލުހިފުމަކަށް ނޫން.
shots.narration_english: Moosa said, weeping. Ashham stood and put his hand on Moosa's shoulder. As he understood it, Naail had not been killed only for revenge.
shots.speaker: moosa

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާއަށް ކޮށްފައިވާ އަނިޔާތަކުގެ މާނައަކީ، އެއްވެސް ވާހަކައެއް ނުދައްކާށޭ މިއީ. އަދި އެއްވެސް އެއްޗެއްގައި އަތްނުލާށޭ، ނުވަތަ އެއްވެސް އެއްޗެއް ހާމަނުކުރާށޭ މިއީ.
shots.narration_english: The meaning of what was done to him was: don't say a word. And don't touch anything, or don't reveal anything.

beats.new_image_reason: time and scene change: 2:30 am, the fast launch leaves Kooddoo towards Kandu-huttaa
beats.location: a police fast launch at speed on a rough dark sea at night: a sleek modern grey-and-navy patrol launch with a raised cabin with windows, plain hull with no writing, numbers or name, white spray and a long white wake
beats.mood: 2 am, cold navy-blue darkness over a rough sea, faint moonlight, the launch's own small white navigation lights, white spray glistening, tense
beats.visual: a sleek police fast launch racing across a rough black sea at night, its bow lifting over a wave, white spray flying, a long white wake behind it, small white navigation lights, the dark horizon
beats.camera: wide shot, low angle near the water, the launch in the upper two-thirds, dark churning water as the calm lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: މިއީ އިންޒާރެއް. ސީދާ ކަނޑުމައްޗަށް. މެންދަމުން އަލިވެ ދެގަޑި ބައިވަނީ.
shots.narration_english: This is a warning. Straight onto the sea: it is half past two in the morning.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ފުލުހުންގެ އެންމެ ދުވެލިބާރު، ޒަމާނީ ލޯންޗު ސީ ހޯކް ކޫއްޑޫ ފަޅުން ނުކުމެ ދުއްވާލި. ކޫއްޑޫ އެއާޕޯޓަށް ފޭބި އަޝްހަމްގެ ޓީމު ގޮވައިގެން އެ ލޯންޗު އެދަނީ ކަނޑުހުއްޓާ އޮންނަ ސަރަހައްދަށް.
shots.narration_english: The police's fastest modern launch, Sea Hawk, sped out of Kooddoo harbour. Carrying Ashham's team, who had flown into Kooddoo airport, the launch is heading for the Kandu-huttaa area.

beats.new_image_reason: scene change: inside the cabin — Ashham and Habeeb silent beside the forensic cases; Habeeb opens his laptop
beats.location: inside the cabin of the police fast launch at night: narrow padded seats, small square windows onto the black sea, hard-shell forensic equipment cases stacked on the floor, a steering wheel and a navigation screen at the front glowing with blurred shapes only, no readable digits
beats.mood: 2 am, a dark cabin lit only by the cold blue glow of a laptop and the faint green glow of the navigation screen, black windows, sea spray on the glass, tense silence
beats.visual: inside the dark launch cabin, Habeeb sitting with an open laptop on his knees, its cold blue glow on his glasses and face (the screen angled away from the viewer), turning to speak; Ashham sitting beside him, arms folded, listening hard; hard-shell forensic cases stacked at their feet; black windows with sea spray
beats.camera: medium shot, eye level, faces in the upper two-thirds, a calm uncluttered lower third (cabin floor with the cases in shadow)

shots.narration_dhivehi: ކަނޑު ގަދަ. ލޯންޗު ރާޅުތަކުގެ މަތިން ބާރު ސްޕީޑުގައި ދުއްވާއިރު، އަޝްހަމް އާއި ހަބީބު ތިބީ ހިމޭނުން. ކައިރީގައި ފޮރެންސިކް ސާމާނުތައް ހުރި.
shots.narration_english: The sea is rough. As the launch sped over the waves, Ashham and Habeeb sat in silence. Beside them were the forensic cases.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ތަހުގީގު ޓީމުގެ ބައެއް މީހުންނާއި އިތުރު ފުލުހުން ވަނީ އެ ސަރަހައްދުގަ. ބެކަޕް ޓީމާއި އިތުރު އެހީއަށް ތައްޔާރުވެފައިވާ ސިފައިންގެ ޓީމެއްވެސް އޮތީ އިޝާރާތަކަށް ތައްޔާރަށް.
shots.narration_english: Some members of the investigation team and extra police are already in that area. A backup team and a team of soldiers ready to help are also standing by for a signal.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހަބީބު، ނާއިލްގެ ފޯނުގެ އެންމެ ފަހުގެ ލޮކޭޝަންތައް ބެލިންތަ؟ އަޝްހަމް އެހި. ލެޕްޓޮޕް ހުޅުވާލަމުން ހަބީބު ބުނި. އާދެ ސަރ.
shots.narration_english: Habeeb, did you check the last locations of Naail's phone? Ashham asked. Opening his laptop, Habeeb said: Yes, sir.
shots.speaker: ashham

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ފޯނު މާލެއިން ނިވުނީ މީގެ ހަފުތާއެއް ކުރިން. އެކަމަކު އޭގެ ކުރިން އޭނާ ދެކުނުގެ އެކި ރަށްރަށުގެ ނަންބަރުތަކަށް ގުޅާފައި އެބަހުރި.
shots.narration_english: His phone went dead in Malé a week ago. But before that he had called numbers on various islands in the south.
shots.speaker: habeeb

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޚާއްސަކޮށް އެއް ނަންބަރަކަށް ވަރަށް ގިނައިން ގުޅާފައިވޭ. އެއީ އެ އަތޮޅު ހޮސްޕިޓަލުގެ ނަންބަރެއް. ހޮސްޕިޓަލޭ!
shots.narration_english: He called one number especially often. It's a number of that atoll's hospital. A hospital!
shots.speaker: habeeb

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަޝްހަމް ވިސްނާލި. ނާއިލްއަކީ ބަލި މީހެއް ނޫން. އޭނާ ހޮސްޕިޓަލަކަށް ގުޅަންޖެހޭ ސަބަބަކީ ކޮބާ؟
shots.narration_english: Ashham thought. Naail isn't a sick man. Why would he need to call a hospital?
shots.speaker: ashham

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެ ނަންބަރު ބޭނުންކުރަނީ ކާކުތޯ ބަލަން އަޅުގަނޑު އެބަ މަސައްކަތްކުރަން. އެކަމަކު އެ ރަށުގެ ސިސްޓަމްތައް ބްލޮކްވެފައި ހުރީ. ހަބީބު ބުނި.
shots.narration_english: I'm working on finding out who uses that number. But that island's systems are blocked. Habeeb said.
shots.speaker: habeeb

beats.new_image_reason: action change: Ashham looks out of the window into the darkness — the most dangerous case of his life
beats.location: inside the cabin of the police fast launch at night: narrow padded seats, small square windows onto the black sea, hard-shell forensic equipment cases stacked on the floor, a steering wheel and a navigation screen at the front glowing with blurred shapes only, no readable digits

beats.camera: close-up profile, eye level, faces in the upper two-thirds, a calm uncluttered lower third (dark window sill)

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަޝްހަމް ލޯންޗުގެ ކުޑަދޮރުން ބޭރަށް ބަލާލި. ކަނޑުގެ އަނދިރިކަމުގެ ތެރެއިން އެއްވެސް އެއްޗެއް ނުފެނޭ.
shots.narration_english: Ashham looked out of the launch's small window. Nothing could be seen in the darkness of the sea.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާއަށް އިހުސާސްވަމުންދިޔައީ މިއީ އޭނާގެ ހަޔާތުގައިވެސް ދިމާވާނެ އެންމެ ނުރައްކާތެރި އަދި އާދަޔާ ޚިލާފު އެއް މައްސަލައަށް ވާނެ ކަމަށް.
shots.narration_english: He felt that this would be the most dangerous and unusual case he would ever face in his life.

beats.new_image_reason: character change: the launch captain reports half an hour to Kandu-huttaa; Ashham gives orders
beats.location: inside the cabin of the police fast launch at night: narrow padded seats, small square windows onto the black sea, hard-shell forensic equipment cases stacked on the floor, a steering wheel and a navigation screen at the front glowing with blurred shapes only, no readable digits

beats.visual: a middle-aged Maldivian launch captain in a light-grey long-sleeved shirt at the wheel, glancing back over his shoulder; Ashham standing behind him with one hand on the cabin roof rail, pointing ahead through the windscreen into the dark, giving orders; the navigation screen glowing with blurred shapes
beats.camera: medium shot from the back of the cabin, eye level, faces in the upper two-thirds, a calm uncluttered lower third (dark cabin floor)

shots.narration_dhivehi: މާލޭގެ މުއްސަނދިކަމާއި، ރާއްޖެތެރޭގެ ފަޅުކަމުގެ ތެރޭގައި ފޮރުވިފައިވާ މި ސިއްރަކީ ކޮބައިބާ؟ ސަރ، އަޅުގަނޑުމެންނަށް ކަނޑުހުއްޓާއާ ހަމައަށް ދެވެން އަދި
shots.narration_english: What could this secret be, hidden between Malé's wealth and the emptiness of the islands? Sir, to reach Kandu-huttaa it'll still take us
shots.speaker: captain

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބައިގަޑިއެއްހާއިރު ވާނެ. ލޯންޗުގެ ކެޕްޓަން ބުނި. ރަނގަޅު. އެ ރަށަށް ފުރަތަމަ ދާނީ. މަސްވެރިން ހަށިގަނޑު ނެގި ސަރަހައްދު ބަލަންޖެހޭނެ.
shots.narration_english: about half an hour. The launch captain said. Good. We go to that island first. We have to check the area where the fishermen picked up the body.
shots.speaker: ashham

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެތަނުގައި އެއްވެސް އިތުރުކަމެއް އުޅޭތޯ ބަލަންޖެހޭނެ. އަޝްހަމް އަމުރުކުރި. ލޯންޗުގެ އިންޖީނުގެ އަޑާއެކު، އެމީހުން ދިޔައީ ކަނޑުގެ ބިޔަ ރާޅުތައް ކަފަމުން.
shots.narration_english: We have to see whether anything else is going on there. Ashham ordered. With the sound of the launch's engine, they went on cutting through the great waves of the sea.
shots.speaker: ashham

beats.new_image_reason: time and scene change: dawn, the launch enters the lagoon of the beautiful, silent island

beats.camera: wide shot from behind the launch, eye level, the island and sky in the upper two-thirds, smooth lagoon water as the calm lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެއީ ފެށުން. ކަނޑުހުއްޓާގެ ހަގީގަތް. ފަތިހުގެ އަލިކަން ފާޅުވަމުންގޮސް އިރުގެ ރަން ދޯދިތައް ކަނޑުގެ ލޮނގަނޑަށް އެޅެން ފެށި.
shots.narration_english: That was the beginning. The truth of Kandu-huttaa. The light of dawn spread, and the sun's golden rays began to fall on the sea's surface.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ސީ ހޯކް ކަނޑުހުއްޓާގެ ފަޅަށް ވަން. އެއީ ގުދުރަތީ ގޮތުން ރީތި، ހިތްގައިމު ރަށެއް. ނަމަވެސް ބިރުވެރި ހިމޭންކަމެއް ވެރިވެފައިވާ ފަޅުރަށެއް.
shots.narration_english: Sea Hawk entered Kandu-huttaa's lagoon. It's a naturally beautiful, charming island. Yet a deserted island ruled by a frightening silence.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ރަށުގެ ވަށައިގެންވަނީ ސާފު ހުދު ދޮންވެލި ގޮނޑުދޮށް. ހޭޅިފަށުގައި ވަނީ ބޯކޮށް ހެދިފައިވާ ބޯށިގަސްތަކާއި މަގޫގަސް.
shots.narration_english: All around the island is a clean white sand beach. At the edge of the vegetation grow dense screwpine and magoo bushes.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބައެއް ހިސާބުތަކުގައި ކުރެދިގަސްތައް ބޯކޮށްހެދި ގޮނޑުދޮށުން ގޮސް ރާޅުފަށާ ހަމައަށް ފައިބާފައިވޭ. ރަށުގެ މަލަމަތިން ފެނުނުހެން ރަށުގައި ރުއްގަސް ވަރަށް ބޯކޮށް ހެދިފައިވޭ.
shots.narration_english: In some places the bushes have grown thick and run from the beach down to the water's edge. Seen from the shore, the island's vegetation is very dense.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ދެން ތިބި ފުލުހުންވެސް ހުށިޔާރުކަމާއެކު ބިޔަ ގަސްގަހުގެ ނިވަލުގައި ތިބި. ސިފައިންގެ މީހުން ހަތިޔާރާއެކު ސަމާލުވެލި.
shots.narration_english: The other police too took cover carefully behind big trees. The soldiers, weapons ready, stayed alert.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ފުލުހުން މި ރަށަށް އައިކަން ކޮންމެވެސް ބަޔަކަށް އެނގިއްޖެ. އަދި އެ ބަޔަކު މިހާރު އެއަންނަނީ އެމީހުންގެ ފަހަތުން. ނުނިމޭ. ބާކީ ދެވަނަ ބައިގަ.
shots.narration_english: Someone knew the police had come to this island. And those people are now coming after them. To be continued in part two.
